Reviewed 2026-10-12 (failing): HTMLCollection supported properties are non-deletable (the DOM4 draft referenced by HTML 5.0 (WD-dom-20140710) section 6.1.1 supported property names; the Web IDL dependency referenced by HTML 5.0 legacy platform object [[Delete]]) — failing assertion: strict-mode delete of an indexed or named supported property must throw TypeError (2/4 subtests: Strict id, Strict name) — engine gap: delete succeeds on supported properties instead of failing as non-configurable

Reviewed 2026-10-12 (failing): getElementsByTagNameNS on Document and Element (the DOM4 draft referenced by HTML 5.0 (WD-dom-20140710) section 6.4 Elements) and the empty-string named getter (section 6.1.1: the empty string is never a supported property name) — failing assertion: Document.getElementsByTagNameNS / Element.getElementsByTagNameNS do not exist (2/7 subtests report "not a function"); the five empty-string subtests pass — engine gap: getElementsByTagNameNS is not implemented on the script-facing Document/Element wrappers

Reviewed 2026-10-12 (failing): HTMLCollection iteration (the DOM4 draft referenced by HTML 5.0 (WD-dom-20140710) section 6.1.1 defines only length, item, namedItem; Symbol.iterator and the iterable declaration post-date the 2014 snapshot) — failing assertion: Symbol.iterator in collection and the for-of subtest fail (2/6); the forEach-absence subtest also fails because the engine exposes a forEach extension — engine gap: the iterable-declaration subtests are post-target, but the engine's extra forEach diverges from the 2014 interface surface; re-review if the interface-objects package changes the surface

Reviewed 2026-10-12 (failing): HTMLCollection live-ness and supported property name enumeration (the DOM4 draft referenced by HTML 5.0 (WD-dom-20140710) section 6.1.1 supported property names: tree-order IDs and name attributes) — failing assertion: Object.getOwnPropertyNames must not surface an unexpected indexed "0" alongside the named properties (1/5 subtests: HTMLCollection ownPropertyNames) — engine gap: enumeration of the live collection's own properties diverges from the supported-property-name list

Reviewed 2026-10-12 (failing): HTMLCollection named/indexed property [[Set]] and [[DefineOwnProperty]] (the DOM4 draft referenced by HTML 5.0 (WD-dom-20140710) section 6.1.1; the Web IDL dependency referenced by HTML 5.0 legacy platform object property semantics) — failing assertion: strict-mode assignment to a supported named property must throw TypeError; assignments must not shadow named or indexed properties (3/8 subtests) — engine gap: supported-property writes succeed and shadow the collection's own properties

Reviewed 2026-10-12 (failing): HTMLCollection indexed property names around the 2^32 boundary (the DOM4 draft referenced by HTML 5.0 (WD-dom-20140710) section 6.1.1 supported property names; the Web IDL dependency referenced by HTML 5.0 canonical numeric string handling) — failing assertion: indices at and beyond 2^32-1 must behave as named properties; expanding defineProperty of an existing index must throw (4/7 subtests) — engine gap: boundary indices resolve to null and expando definitions shadow existing indices

Reviewed 2026-10-12 (failing): HTMLCollection supported property names enumeration (the DOM4 draft referenced by HTML 5.0 (WD-dom-20140710) section 6.1.1: tree-order IDs then name attributes, plus canonical numeric indices) — failing assertion: Object.getOwnPropertyNames must list exactly the indices and supported names (4/6 subtests; the engine lists prototype members and omits named properties) — engine gap: own-property enumeration includes prototype methods and misses named properties

Reviewed 2026-10-12 (failing): DOMStringMap supported property names (HTML 5.0 section 2.7.3: dataset enumerates the data-* attribute names with hyphen-to-camelCase mapping) — failing assertion: Object.getOwnPropertyNames on a DOMStringMap must list the data attribute-derived names, including the empty data attribute and trailing-hyphen forms (2/5 subtests) — engine gap: the confirmed DOMStringMap enumeration gap documented in the confirmed-gap table

Reviewed 2026-10-12 (failing): NamedNodeMap supported property names and enumeration (DOM4 2014 NamedNodeMap: indexed own properties plus attribute-name named properties) — failing assertion: Object.getOwnPropertyNames must list the indices and attribute names and nothing else (3/3 subtests) — engine gap: enumeration exposes prototype members (length/item/getNamedItem/...) and omits attribute names

Reviewed 2026-10-12 (failing): DOMTokenList stringifier (DOM4 2014 DOMTokenList: the stringifier returns the reflected content attribute value verbatim, without token normalization; HTML 5.0 section 2.4 whitespace handling) — failing assertion: String(classList) must return "   a  a b " exactly, and classList.toString() likewise (1/1 subtests) — engine gap: the stringifier normalizes whitespace instead of reflecting the attribute verbatim

Reviewed 2026-10-12 (failing): DOMTokenList coverage for reflected token attributes (DOM4 2014 DOMTokenList + HTML 5.0 attribute reflections; the 2014 target reflects iframe.sandbox and td/th.headers as DOMSettableTokenList) — failing assertion: 41/175 subtests fail, concentrated in attribute/interface pairs introduced after the 2014 snapshot — engine gap: mixed-era coverage matrix: post-target pairs dominate the failures; a per-pair inventory is only worth building once the interface-objects work settles the 2014 surface

Reviewed 2026-10-12 (failing): TreeWalker filter invocation (DOM4 2014 section 6.2 Traversal: a null/undefined filter means no per-node filtering; otherwise acceptNode is called) — failing assertion: null filter must act as no-filter (2/12 subtests fail with "cannot read property acceptNode of null") — engine gap: createTreeWalker does not normalize a null filter to the no-filter path

Reviewed 2026-10-12 (failing): createTreeWalker argument handling (DOM4 2014 section 6.2 Traversal; the Web IDL dependency referenced by HTML 5.0 optional-argument defaults) — failing assertion: createTreeWalker(root, undefined, undefined) must apply the whatToShow/filter defaults (2/6 subtests) — engine gap: undefined whatToShow/filter are not converted to the default (4294967295 / null)

Reviewed 2026-10-12 (failing): TreeWalker currentNode setter (DOM4 2014 section 6.2 Traversal: setting currentNode to a non-Node value must throw TypeError) — failing assertion: assigning non-Node values must throw (2/4 subtests) — engine gap: the setter accepts non-Node values without the interface-type check

Reviewed 2026-10-12 (failing): TreeWalker nextNode from a detached currentNode (DOM4 2014 section 6.2 Traversal: nextNode returns null when no node follows in document order) — failing assertion: nextNode() must return null for a detached currentNode (3/3 subtests) — engine gap: nextNode misbehaves when the current node is detached from its document

Reviewed 2026-10-12 (failing): TreeWalker previousNode filter respect (DOM4 2014 section 6.2 Traversal: filtering steps apply to previousNode, rejecting subtrees as required) — failing assertion: previousNode must honour FILTER_REJECT on the last child (1/1 subtest) — engine gap: the previousNode walk does not apply the filter's reject semantics correctly
